name: Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub
description: Epoch AI's database of benchmark results for frontier models. Some benchmarks (GPQA Diamond, FrontierMath, SWE-bench Verified, SimpleQA Verified, MirrorCode) are evaluated internally with Inspect AI under documented, consistent settings and error bars; others (ARC-AGI, Terminal-Bench, HLE, MMLU) are collected from official leaderboards or primary sources and labelled as such. Data are CC-BY and downloadable, making it a standard source for capability trend analysis independent of lab marketing.
description_zh: Epoch AI 的前沿模型基准结果数据库。部分基准(GPQA Diamond、FrontierMath、SWE-bench Verified、SimpleQA Verified、MirrorCode)由其内部使用 Inspect AI 在有文档记录的一致设置下评估并附误差线;其他基准(ARC-AGI、Terminal-Bench、HLE、MMLU)从官方排行榜或一手来源收集并如实标注。数据采用 CC-BY 许可且可下载,使其成为独立于实验室宣传的能力趋势分析的标准来源。
notes: Launched 2024-11-27 (epoch.ai/latest/introducing-benchmarks-dashboard). Methodology is mixed: internal runs via Inspect plus externally collected results; recorded as self-run since that is its distinguishing feature. Benchmark pages verified at epoch.ai/benchmarks/{gpqa-diamond,frontiermath,swe-bench-verified,simple-qa-verified,hle,arc-agi,arc-agi-2,terminal-bench,mmlu}. License applies to Epoch's own data.
